name: Question list
summary: An editable list of collapsible questions laid out as the settings lab's QuestionList — a SettingRow head with the question count, a Collapse per question (prompt field plus OptionRow choices), and full-width secondary Add option / Add question buttons (SETTINGS-31/36).
highlights: A Collapse per question: “N. prompt” header, prompt field, OptionRow choices
lead: ONE custom element — <aha-question-list> — the composite settings surface for an editable list of questions (SETTINGS-31/36), laid out as the settings lab's QuestionList and composed only from DS components. The head is a SettingRow: the list label (with an optional "?" help) LEFT and the "N questions" count RIGHT. Each question is a bordered DS Collapse whose header reads "N. <prompt>" ("Untitled question" while empty) with a tertiary small trash Button and a "Delete question" tooltip on its trailing edge; inside, a stacked SettingRow "Question" over a CountedInput, then a stacked SettingRow "Options" over the question's OptionRows (drag handle, correct toggle, optional image with `allowimage`) and a full-width "Add option" AddItemButton. A full-width "Add question" AddItemButton sits under the list. Limits: the add buttons disable at `max` / `maxoptions`, the deletes at `min` / `minoptions` (SETTINGS-36). Shadow-DOM CSS, themed only by --aha-* tokens. Emits composed `change` CustomEvent<{questions}> on every edit.
codeNote: A composite element that COMPOSES DS components — SettingRow, Collapse, CountedInput, OptionRow, AddItemButton, Button and Tooltip — never re-implementing them. Set the model as a property (`el.questions = [...]`) or a JSON attribute. React (< 19) via a thin ref wrapper; Vue binds natively.

spec.label: Head
spec.value: SettingRow: label 14/21 regular (+ optional "?" help) LEFT, "N questions" count 12/18 #4A4A4A RIGHT

spec.label: Question
spec.value: bordered DS Collapse, caret leading, header "N. <prompt>"; open state kept per question (`open` in the model; a new question opens)

spec.label: Delete
spec.value: tertiary small icon Button (28, system-trash) with a "Delete question" tooltip on the header's trailing edge; disabled at min

spec.label: Body
spec.value: stacked SettingRow "Question" + CountedInput (120), then stacked SettingRow "Options" + OptionRows (orderable, correctable, image with allowimage) + full-width "Add option"

spec.label: Add question
spec.value: full-width AddItemButton (the secondary Button, 36 high), 12px under the list, disabled at max (SETTINGS-31)

spec.label: Limits
spec.value: no "X of Y" counter — the add buttons disable at max / maxoptions, the deletes at min / minoptions (SETTINGS-36)

props.name: questions
props.desc: The model; set as a property or a JSON attribute. `open` starts that question expanded

props.name: label
props.desc: The list label in the head row

props.name: help
props.desc: Adds the "?" help tooltip after the label

props.name: min
props.desc: Minimum questions — delete disables at this count

props.name: max
props.desc: Maximum questions — +Add disables at this count

props.name: minoptions
props.desc: Minimum options per question — option delete disables at this count

props.name: maxoptions
props.desc: Maximum options per question — +Add option disables at this count

props.name: allowimage
props.desc: Give every option the per-option image control; its image-add/change/edit/delete intents bubble out

props.name: change
props.desc: Composed event on any edit; read e.detail.questions (the full model)

whenToUse.when: an editable set of questions, each with its own prompt + choices (a quiz builder, a survey)
a flat list of options for ONE question — compose OptionRow directly

opinion.note: The add buttons span the full panel width (SETTINGS-31) — never hugged to one side. The "N questions" count is a total, never an "X of Y" (SETTINGS-36): the add buttons disable at max and the deletes at min. Composes SettingRow, Collapse, CountedInput, OptionRow and AddItemButton; it does not re-implement any of them.
opinion.dsv3: COVERED — the settings-lab QuestionList mapped into the DS: an Ant Collapse per question in the lab, the DS Collapse here; the lab's SettingRow + Input prompt, OptionRow answers and default-Button adds are the DS SettingRow, CountedInput, OptionRow and AddItemButton. Two lab details stay the DS Collapse's own look: the lab header is 14 regular on a 2% grey fill, the DS header 15 semibold on white.
